paper.title: Leaderboard Incentives: Model Rankings under Strategic Post-Training

claims.paper_claim: A pure Nash equilibrium generally need not exist.
claims.source_anchor: Assumptions 4.1–4.2 and the general nonexistence result
production_path: repro/src/exact_theory.py constructs an admitted continuous follower game
Z3 checks an exhaustive partition of nonnegative effort pairs
repro/src/check_exact_theory.py independently reads the obligations and negative control
evidence/claim_1 records the contract, raw output, control, and limitations
claims.boundary: The result verifies the existential claim through the encoded continuous witness; it is not a proof that every admitted game lacks a PNE.

production_path: repro/src/exact_theory.py encodes cost max(e-1,0)^2, equal rewards, and efforts [0, 0.75]
Z3 checks both players' deviations, the inverted ranking, and the flat-cost condition
repro/src/check_exact_theory.py checks the linear-cost negative control
evidence/claim_2 records the assumption audit and counterexample
claims.boundary: The counterexample satisfies the written assumptions encoded by the audit and contradicts the universal written claim; a narrower unstated cost condition could change the result.

claims.paper_claim: If the adjacent just-overtake cost is below the reward gap, no PNE exists.
production_path: repro/src/exact_theory.py constructs efforts [1,1], reward gap 0.1, and zero baseline just-overtake cost
Z3 checks both players' deviations and the written antecedent
repro/src/check_exact_theory.py checks the c(e)=e negative control
evidence/claim_3 records the exact counterexample
claims.boundary: The result isolates the flat-cost counterexample under the registered contract and does not infer author intent.

claims.paper_claim: Tune-before-test induces a unique equilibrium ranked by latent quality, with monotone stabilization.
claims.source_anchor: Proposition 5.3 and the aggregate tune-before-test discussion
production_path: repro/src/exact_theory.py checks the two profiles [1,0] and [1,1] for every nonnegative TbT level
The exact checks also show that the all-zero profile has a profitable deviation
repro/src/check_exact_theory.py preserves the strictly increasing-cost negative control
evidence/claim_4 records why the narrower conditional proposition is not contradicted
claims.boundary: Aggregate uniqueness is falsified for the admitted flat-cost example; the narrower Proposition 5.3 antecedent is explicitly reported as untriggered.

claims.paper_claim: Under the written generalized scaling assumptions and c(e)>=kappa*e, a stabilizing threshold exists and is O(lambda^gamma).
production_path: repro/src/exact_theory.py constructs the exact generalized-logit family with L(theta)=theta/(1+theta)
Z3 checks the catch-up identity and the reward-versus-cost contradiction for every TbT level
The monotone-intercept control is checked separately to expose the missing condition
evidence/claim_5 records both interpretation routes and the control
claims.boundary: The counterexample follows the displayed C1–C3 and cost conditions; adding monotonicity of alpha would be a different contract and excludes this witness.

claims.paper_claim: Figure 1 implies at least 384,668 additional Winogrande steps at common TbT 3,000.
production_path: repro/src/claim6_figure.py downloads the hash-pinned arXiv source and reconstructs the plotted endpoint
The source vector and PDF geometry produce 384667.5594951132, which rounds to 384668
Independent TeX anchors and endpoint-blind extrapolation are retained as corroborating routes
repro/src/check_claim6.py checks the reconstruction and mutated-tick negative control
evidence/claim_6 records why the raw empirical rerun remains unavailable
claims.boundary: Raw Winogrande measurements, fit parameters, training code, and checkpoints are absent from the audited bundle, so source-display reconstruction is not promoted to an empirical rerun.
